To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimal sampling of breast cancer patients before first line chemotherapy consists in cytopuncture and cutting needle biopsy.
the optimal pre-therapeutic diagnostic and prognostistic sampling for breast cancer is the combination of a cytopuncture with a cutting-needle biopsy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) what are the advantages of cytopuncture in the pre-therapeutic assessment of breast cancer?;

the following points: 1) the reliability and safety of cytopuncture; 2) the reliability and the prognostic value of the histological diagnosis of breast tumors; 3) the value of the histologic diagnosis for the choice of treatment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most reliable method of pre-therapeutical tissue sampling is cutting-needle biopsy.
cytopuncture is the best way of obtaining diagnostic information, while microbiopsy is the best way to get prognostic information.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cytopuncture is the most reliable and least invasive procedure for the preoperative assessment of breast cancer.

, for a patient with a breast lump of unknown nature, cytopuncture is the safest and most informative diagnostic method; if a malignant tumour is found, the best procedure is to perform a cutting-needle biopsy to determine the nature of the tumour.
the best pre-chemotherapy information is obtained by combining the results of cytopuncture, cutting needle biopsy, and histological study of a surgical biopsy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cytopuncture is an excellent method for collecting diagnostic and prognostically significant information.
the most important prognostic factors are: the histological grade (G), the number of positive nodes (N) and the estrogen receptor (ER).
, when a non-surgical first-line treatment is planned for a patient with operable breast cancer, it is advisable to perform both procedures.
